message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7k -- arm P's start-up precondition bounded and fail-closed: ONE am start, 120 s from it, every SDK call of it capped and reaped

Codex codex_old_apk_lane_p_start_decision_r1.md (choice (나)); on c45fb9b, apart from the old-ref and C prefix work.
The verifier's P (c45fb9b) was INVALID: 0.2.32's cold start had not written its log within wait_log's fixed 30 s.
A bare 30 -> 120 would not have been a bound: oa_adb.adb has no timeout.

p_startup (p_first_connect calls it; nothing else of the arm changes):
- am start exactly ONCE; the budget (P_START_BUDGET_S = 120 s, monotonic) starts there; no warm-up, no re-launch;
- bounded_adb: every SDK call of it (am start, each log pull, the force-stop) runs with timeout = min(P_CALL_CAP_S = 5 s,
  what is left); on a timeout subprocess.run kills its child (adb.exe, a direct child) and waits for it;
- each pull into a NEW file of this run (_pstart_NNN.log): an earlier pull is never read as a new one;
- a failed / timed-out pull, no file yet, an empty log: NOT confirmed -- keep waiting, never a success;
- a log read whole: any auto_login that is not NO_CREDENTIAL, or a sign_in_store line -> INVALID at once (force-stop,
  nothing tapped); NO_CREDENTIAL and no sign_in_store in that SAME read -> on to the manual connect;
- the budget spent -> INVALID, nothing tapped. Every read (elapsed, status, bytes, auto_login / store seen) in
  <out>/p_startup.txt; the confirming read's elapsed in the steps, called a setup allowance, not a cold-start figure.
The 120 s / 5 s are fixed; OA_P_START_BUDGET_S / OA_P_CALL_CAP_S are read only with OA_TEST_FAKE_ADB (the stub).
The slot runs the AVD step with no timeout of its own and the hosts live 2400 s: nothing above cuts the 120 s.

Tests (stub, the real helper and flow, the fake adb, budget 6 s / cap 1 s): oa_pick_test 81/81 -- the log 3 s late
(pulls fail before) -> confirmed, then the manual connect, ONE am start, the first tap after it; an empty log for 3 s ->
not a success, waited; the log only at 9 s (> 6) -> INVALID, no tap, one am start; every pull hanging 4 s -> each cut at
1 s, INVALID at the budget, no tap (12 s in all); auto_login RESTORED / a sign_in_store line -> INVALID at once (3.4 s),
no tap; source: no wait_log / ka.adb left in p_startup. No real run.
